  79:         if value is not None:
  80:             return float(value)
  81:     return default
  82: 
  83: 
  84: def _get_bool(run: Any, *names: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:
  85:     for name in names:
  86:         value = _get_value(run, name, None)
  87:         if value is not None:
  88:             return bool(value)
  89:     return default
  90: 
  91: 
  92: def build_scorecard(run: Any) -> Scorecard:
  93:     """Build a scorecard from a synthetic or real run object."""
  94: 
  95:     tokens_cached = _get_int(run, "tokens_cached", "cached_tokens")
  96:     tokens_fresh = _get_int(run, "tokens_fresh", "fresh_tokens")
  97:     total_tokens = tokens_cached + tokens_fresh
  98:     cache_hit_ratio = (tokens_cached / total_tokens) if total_tokens else 0.0
  99:     action_type_breakdown = _build_action_type_breakdown(run)
 100: 
 101:     grader_reward_raw = _get_value(run, "grader_reward", None)
 102:     grader_reward = float(grader_reward_raw) if grader_reward_raw is not None else None
 103: 
 104:     return Scorecard(
 105:         verifier_clean=_get_bool(run, "verifier_clean", "pass_", "pass", "passed", "success"),
 106:         grader_reward=grader_reward,
 107:         steps=_get_int(run, "steps", "step_count"),
 108:         model_calls=_get_int(run, "model_calls", "model_call_count"),
 109:         tokens_cached=tokens_cached,
 110:         tokens_fresh=tokens_fresh,
 111:         cost=_get_float(run, "cost", "total_cost"),
 112:         wall_time=_get_float(run, "wall_time", "wall_time_sec"),
 113:         cache_hit_ratio=cache_hit_ratio,
 114:         no_delta_streaks=_get_int(run, "no_delta_streaks", "mirror_no_delta_streaks"),
 115:         verification_rounds=_get_int(run, "verification_rounds", "verify_rounds"),
 116:         recoveries=_get_int(run, "recoveries", "recovery_count"),
 117:         compaction_count=_get_int(run, "compaction_count", "compactions"),
 118:         job_survival=_get_bool(run, "job_survival", "jobs_survived"),
 119:         session_survival=_get_bool(run, "session_survival", "sessions_survived"),
 120:         action_type_breakdown=action_type_breakdown,
 121:     )
 122: 
 123: 
 124: def _build_action_type_breakdown(run: Any) -> dict[str, int]:
 125:     counts: dict[str, int] = {}
 126:     for record in _extract_tool_invocations(run):
 127:         tool_name = _record_tool_name(record)
 128:         command = _record_command(record)
 129:         action_type = infer_action_type(tool_name=tool_name, command=command)
 130:         counts[action_type] = counts.get(action_type, 0) + 1
 131:     return dict(sorted(counts.items()))
 132: 
 133: 
 134: def _extract_tool_invocations(run: Any) -> list[Any]:
 135:     for name in ("tool_invocations", "action_records", "tool_calls", "actions", "recorded_actions"):
 136:         value = _get_value(run, name, None)
 137:         if isinstance(value, list):
 138:             return value
 139: 
 140:     action_summary = _get_value(run, "action_summary", None)
 141:     if action_summary is not None:
 142:         records = _record_value(action_summary, "records", None)
 143:         if isinstance(records, list):
 144:             return records
 145: 
 146:     records = _get_value(run, "records", None)
 147:     if isinstance(records, list) and any(_is_action_like_record(item) for item in records):
 148:         return records
 149:     return []
 150: 
 151: 
 152: def _is_action_like_record(record: Any) -> bool:
 153:     if isinstance(record, dict):
 154:         return any(key in record for key in ("tool_name", "name", "command", "arguments", "tool"))
 155:     return any(hasattr(record, attr) for attr in ("tool_name", "name", "command", "arguments", "tool"))
 156: 
 157: 
 158: def _record_tool_name(record: Any) -> str:
 159:     for name in ("tool_name", "name", "tool"):
 160:         value = _record_value(record, name, None)
 161:         if isinstance(value, str) and value:
 162:             return value
 163:     return "raw_bash"
 164: 
 165: 
 166: def _record_command(record: Any) -> str:
 167:     value = _record_value(record, "command", None)
 168:     if isinstance(value, str):
 169:         return value
 170:     if value is not None:
 171:         return extract_command(value)
 172:     arguments = _record_value(record, "arguments", None)
 173:     if arguments is not None:
 174:         return extract_command(arguments)
 175:     tool_call = _record_value(record, "tool_call", None)
 176:     if tool_call is not None:
 177:         tool_call_command = _record_value(tool_call, "command", None)
 178:         if isinstance(tool_call_command, str):
 179:             return tool_call_command
 180:         tool_call_arguments = _record_value(tool_call, "arguments", None)
 181:         if tool_call_arguments is not None:
 182:             return extract_command(tool_call_arguments)
 183:     return ""

===== runner/aether2/orientation.py =====
   1: """Probe the local workspace and runtime into a compact, factual snapshot."""
   2: 
   3: from __future__ import annotations
   4: 
   5: from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
   6: from typing import Any
   7: 
   8: 
   9: @dataclass(frozen=True)
  10: class OrientationSnapshot:
  11:     cwd: str
  12:     user: str
  13:     is_root: bool
  14:     workspace_root: str
  15:     writable_paths: list[str]
  16:     safe_file_listing: list[str]
  17:     tool_presence: dict[str, str]
  18:     package_managers: dict[str, str]
  19:     network: str
  20:     network_reachable: bool
  21:     network_evidence: str

  24:     ports: list[str]
  25: 
  26:     def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
  27:         return asdict(self)
  28: 
  29: 
  30: NETWORK_PROBE_COMMANDS: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
  31:     (
  32:         "python3 -c \"import socket; s=socket.create_connection(('pypi.org', 443), 3); s.close(); print('reachable: pypi.org:443')\"",
  33:         "python3 direct DNS+TCP probe",
  34:     ),
  35:     (
  36:         "python -c \"import socket; s=socket.create_connection(('pypi.org', 443), 3); s.close(); print('reachable: pypi.org:443')\"",
  37:         "python direct DNS+TCP probe",
  38:     ),
  39:     (
  40:         "sh -lc 'curl -Is --max-time 3 https://pypi.org | head -n 1'",
  41:         "curl HEAD probe",
  42:     ),
  43: )
  44: 
  45: 
  46: def _read_text(result: Any) -> str:
  47:     if result is None:
  48:         return ""
  49:     if isinstance(result, str):
  50:         return result
  51:     if isinstance(result, dict):
  52:         for key in ("stdout", "output", "text", "content", "result"):
  53:             value = result.get(key)
  54:             if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
  55:                 return value
  56:         stderr = result.get("stderr")
  57:         if isinstance(stderr, str):
  58:             return stderr
  59:         return ""
  60:     for attr in ("stdout", "output", "text", "content", "result"):
  61:         value = getattr(result, attr, None)
  62:         if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
  63:             return value
  64:     stderr = getattr(result, "stderr", None)
  65:     if isinstance(stderr, str):
  66:         return stderr
  67:     return ""
  68: 
  69: 
  70: def _exit_code(result: Any) -> int | None:
  71:     if result is None:
  72:         return None
  73:     if isinstance(result, dict):
  74:         for key in ("exit_code", "returncode", "code", "status"):
  75:             value = result.get(key)
  76:             if isinstance(value, int):
  77:                 return value
  78:         return None
  79:     for attr in ("exit_code", "returncode", "code", "status"):
  80:         value = getattr(result, attr, None)
  81:         if isinstance(value, int):
  82:             return value
  83:     return None
  84: 
  85: 
  86: def _probe(executor: Any, command: str, *, cwd: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, bool]:
  87:     raw = executor.run(command, timeout_sec=10, cwd=cwd)
  88:     text = _read_text(raw).strip()
  89:     code = _exit_code(raw)
  90:     success = code == 0 if code is not None else bool(text)
  91:     return text, success
  92: 
  93: 
  94: def _probe_candidates(executor: Any, commands: list[str], *, cwd: str | None = None, missing_value: str = "") -> str:
  95:     for command in commands:
  96:         text, success = _probe(executor, command, cwd=cwd)
  97:         if success:
  98:             return text
  99:     return missing_value
 100: 
 101: 
 102: def _split_lines(text: str, *, limit: int = 40) -> list[str]:
 103:     if not text:
 104:         return []
 105:     lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
 106:     return lines[:limit]
 107: 
 108: 
 109: def _presence_value(text: str) -> str:
 110:     text = text.strip()
 111:     if not text:
 112:         return "missing"
 113:     return text.splitlines()[0].strip()
 114: 
 115: 
 116: def _network_value(text: str) -> str:
 117:     normalized = text.strip().lower()
 118:     if normalized in {"reachable", "online", "connected", "yes"}:
 119:         return "reachable"
 120:     if normalized in {"blocked", "offline", "disconnected", "no"}:
 121:         return "blocked"
 122:     if normalized:
 123:         return normalized.splitlines()[0]
 124:     return "blocked"
 125: 
 126: 
 127: def _probe_presence(executor: Any, commands: list[str], *, cwd: str | None = None) -> str:
 128:     return _probe_candidates(executor, commands, cwd=cwd, missing_value="missing")
 129: 
 130: 
 131: def _probe_network(executor: Any) -> tuple[bool, str]:
 132:     last_evidence = "blocked"
 133:     for command, label in NETWORK_PROBE_COMMANDS:
 134:         text, success = _probe(executor, command)
 135:         if success:
 136:             evidence = text or f"reachable via {label}"
 137:             return True, evidence
 138:         if text and last_evidence == "blocked":
 139:             last_evidence = text
 140:     return False, last_evidence or "blocked"
 141: 
 142: 
 143: def orient(executor: Any) -> OrientationSnapshot:
 144:     cwd = _probe_candidates(executor, ["pwd"]) or ""
 145:     user = _probe_candidates(executor, ["id -un", "whoami"]) or "unavailable"
 146:     is_root = _probe_candidates(executor, ["id -u"]) == "0"
 147:     workspace_root = _probe_candidates(
 148:         executor,
 149:         ["git rev-parse --show-toplevel", "pwd"],
 150:         cwd=cwd or None,
 151:     ) or cwd
 152: 
 153:     writable_paths: list[str] = []
 154:     for path in [p for p in [cwd, workspace_root] if p]:
 155:         writable_probe = _probe_candidates(
 156:             executor,
 157:             [
 158:                 'sh -lc \'[ -w "$PWD" ] && printf writable || printf read-only\'',
 159:                 'python3 -c "import os; print(\'writable\' if os.access(\'.\', os.W_OK) else \'read-only\')"',
 160:             ],
 161:             cwd=path,
 162:         )
 163:         if writable_probe == "writable" and path not in writable_paths:
 164:             writable_paths.append(path)
 165: 
 166:     safe_file_listing = _split_lines(
 167:         _probe_candidates(
 168:             executor,
 169:             [
 170:                 'python3 -c "import os; print(\'\\n\'.join(sorted(os.listdir(\'.\'))[:40]))"',
 171:                 "ls -1A",
 172:             ],
 173:             cwd=workspace_root or cwd or None,
 174:         )
 175:     )
 176: 
 177:     tool_presence = {
 178:         "git": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v git", "git --version"]),
 179:         "curl": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v curl", "curl --version"]),
 180:         "python3": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v python3", "python3 --version"]),
 181:         "gcc": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v gcc", "gcc --version"]),
 182:         "make": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v make", "make --version"]),
 183:         "tmux": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v tmux", "tmux -V"]),
 184:         "node": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v node", "node --version"]),
 185:         "npm": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v npm", "npm --version"]),
 186:         "uv": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v uv", "uv --version"]),
 187:         "pip": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v pip", "pip --version", "python3 -m pip --version"]),
 188:     }
 189: 
 190:     package_managers = {
 191:         "apt": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v apt", "apt --version"]),
 192:         "pip": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v pip", "pip --version", "python3 -m pip --version"]),
 193:         "npm": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v npm", "npm --version"]),
 194:         "uv": _probe_presence(executor, ["command -v uv", "uv --version"]),
 195:     }
 196: 
 197:     network_reachable, network_evidence = _probe_network(executor)
 198:     network = "reachable" if network_reachable else "blocked"
 199: 
 200:     runtimes = {
 201:         "python3": _probe_presence(executor, ["python3 --version", "python3 -V"]),
 202:         "python": _probe_presence(executor, ["python --version", "python -V"]),
 203:         "node": _probe_presence(executor, ["node --version", "node -v"]),
 204:         "npm": _probe_presence(executor, ["npm --version", "npm -v"]),
 205:     }
 206: 
 207:     processes = _split_lines(
 208:         _probe_candidates(
 209:             executor,
 210:             [
 211:                 "ps -eo comm= | head -n 20",
 212:                 "ps -A -o comm= | head -n 20",
 213:             ],
 214:         )
 215:     )
 216: 
 217:     ports = _split_lines(
 218:         _probe_candidates(
 219:             executor,
 220:             [
 221:                 "ss -ltn 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltn 2>/dev/null || true",
 222:                 "netstat -ltn 2>/dev/null || true",
 223:             ],
 224:         )
 225:     )
 226: 
 227:     return OrientationSnapshot(
 228:         cwd=cwd,
 229:         user=user,
 230:         is_root=is_root,
 231:         workspace_root=workspace_root,
 232:         writable_paths=writable_paths,
 233:         safe_file_listing=safe_file_listing,
 234:         tool_presence=tool_presence,
 235:         package_managers=package_managers,
 236:         network=network,
 237:         network_reachable=network_reachable,
 238:         network_evidence=network_evidence,
 239:         runtimes=runtimes,
 240:         processes=processes,
 241:         ports=ports,
 242:     )

===== runner/aether2/model_client.py =====
   1: """Normalized model client wrapper for Aether-2."""
   2: 
   3: from __future__ import annotations
   4: 
   5: from dataclasses import dataclass
   6: from typing import Any
   7: import time
   8: 
   9: from runner.model_client import ModelClientError, TRANSIENT_STATUS_CODES, make_model_client_from_route
  10: 
  11: 
  12: @dataclass(frozen=True)
  13: class ModelResponse:
  14:     text: str
  15:     tool_calls: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]
  16:     usage: dict[str, int]
  17:     status: str
  18:     raw_response: dict[str, Any]
  19: 
  20: 
  21: class Aether2ModelClient:
  22:     """Call the configured provider with native tools and normalized retries."""
  23: 
  24:     def __init__(
  25:         self,
  26:         model_route: dict[str, Any],
  27:         *,
  28:         max_attempts: int = 3,
  29:         backoff_sec: float = 0.5,
  30:         **client_kwargs: Any,
  31:     ) -> None:
  32:         self.model_route = dict(model_route)
  33:         self.max_attempts = max(1, int(max_attempts))
  34:         self.backoff_sec = max(0.0, float(backoff_sec))
  35:         self._client = make_model_client_from_route(self.model_route, **client_kwargs)
  36: 
  37:     def call(self, messages, tools, *, cache_prefix_len: int) -> ModelResponse:
  38:         attempt = 0
  39:         while True:
  40:             attempt += 1
  41:             try:
  42:                 # `cache_prefix_len` is an Aether-2 internal hint for prompt-cache
  43:                 # accounting; the underlying provider clients (e.g.
  44:                 # AzureOpenAIAPIKeyModelClient) forward unrecognized kwargs straight
  45:                 # into the request payload, so it must NOT be passed through here.
  46:                 raw = self._client.complete(
  47:                     list(messages),
  48:                     tools=_flatten_function_tools(tools),
  49:                 )
  50:                 return _normalize_response(raw)
  51:             except ModelClientError as exc:
  52:                 if exc.status_code not in TRANSIENT_STATUS_CODES or attempt >= self.max_attempts:
  53:                     raise
  54:                 time.sleep(self.backoff_sec * attempt)
  55: 
  56: 
  57: def _flatten_function_tools(tools: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  58:     """Flatten Responses-API-shaped tool specs for the Chat Completions surface.
  59: 
  60:     `runner.aether2.tools.TOOL_SCHEMAS` (and Aether-2's `call()` signature in
  61:     general) use the Responses-API tool shape:
  62:         {"type": "function", "function": {"name": ..., "parameters": ...}}
  63: 
  64:     `runner.model_client`'s Chat Completions tool normalizer
  65:     (`_normalize_chat_completions_tools`) expects the flat Chat Completions
  66:     shape:
  67:         {"type": "function", "name": ..., "parameters": ...}
  68: 
  69:     and silently drops any tool dict that doesn't have a top-level "name"
  70:     (because `_normalize_request_tools` passes dicts with a string "type"
  71:     through unchanged). Without this flattening, no tools reach the model and
  72:     it falls back to narrating actions as plain text instead of calling
  73:     tools. This flattening is a no-op for tool specs that are already flat.
  74:     """
  75:     flattened: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  76:     for tool in list(tools):
  77:         if not isinstance(tool, dict):
  78:             continue
  79:         if tool.get("type") == "function" and isinstance(tool.get("function"), dict):
  80:             function_spec = dict(tool["function"])
  81:             flat = {"type": "function", **function_spec}
  82:             flattened.append(flat)
  83:         else:
  84:             flattened.append(dict(tool))
  85:     return flattened
  86: 
  87: 
  88: def _normalize_response(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> ModelResponse:
  89:     usage_raw = raw.get("usage")
  90:     usage_dict = dict(usage_raw) if isinstance(usage_raw, dict) else {}
  91:     input_tokens = max(0, _coerce_int(usage_dict.get("input_tokens")))
  92:     cached_input_tokens = max(0, _coerce_int(usage_dict.get("cached_input_tokens")))
  93:     output_tokens = max(0, _coerce_int(usage_dict.get("output_tokens")))
  94:     total_tokens = max(0, _coerce_int(usage_dict.get("total_tokens"))) or (
  95:         input_tokens + output_tokens
  96:     )
  97:     usage = {
  98:         "input_tokens": input_tokens,
  99:         "cached_input_tokens": cached_input_tokens,
 100:         "fresh_input_tokens": max(0, input_tokens - cached_input_tokens),
 101:         "output_tokens": output_tokens,
 102:         "total_tokens": total_tokens,
 103:     }
 104:     tool_calls_raw = raw.get("tool_calls")
 105:     tool_calls = (
 106:         tuple(dict(tool) for tool in tool_calls_raw if isinstance(tool, dict))
 107:         if isinstance(tool_calls_raw, list)
 108:         else ()
 109:     )
 110:     return ModelResponse(
 111:         text=str(raw.get("text", "")),
 112:         tool_calls=tool_calls,
 113:         usage=usage,
 114:         status=str(raw.get("status", "")),
 115:         raw_response=dict(raw),
 116:     )
 117: 
 118: 
 119: def _coerce_int(value: Any) -> int:
 120:     if isinstance(value, bool):
 121:         return 0
 122:     if isinstance(value, int):
 123:         return value
 124:     if isinstance(value, float):
 125:         return int(value)
 126:     if isinstance(value, str):
 127:         try:
 128:             return int(value)
 129:         except ValueError:
 130:             return 0
 131:     return 0

===== runner/aether2/receipts.py =====
   1: """Model-invisible receipt capture for Aether-2."""
   2: 
   3: from __future__ import annotations
   4: 
   5: import base64
   6: import hashlib
   7: import json
   8: import math
   9: from dataclasses import dataclass, fields, is_dataclass
  10: from collections.abc import Mapping
  11: from pathlib import Path
  12: from types import SimpleNamespace
  13: from typing import Any
  14: 
  15: __all__ = ["ReceiptWriter"]
  16: 
  17: _MAX_LABEL_LEN = 40
  18: 
  19: 
  20: def _safe_action_name(action: Any) -> str:
  21:     text = _label_for_path(action)
  22:     safe = []
  23:     for char in text:
  24:         if char.isalnum() or char in {"_", "-", "."}:
  25:             safe.append(char)
  26:         else:
  27:             safe.append("_")
  28:     sanitized = "".join(safe)
  29:     if len(sanitized) <= _MAX_LABEL_LEN:
  30:         return sanitized
  31:     digest = hashlib.sha256(sanitized.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8]
  32:     return f"{sanitized[:_MAX_LABEL_LEN]}_{digest}"
  33: 
  34: 
  35: def _type_name(value: Any) -> str:
  36:     cls = value.__class__
  37:     return f"{cls.__module__}.{cls.__qualname__}"
  38: 
  39: 
  40: def _normalize_key(value: Any) -> str:
  41:     normalized = _normalize_for_json(value)
  42:     if isinstance(normalized, str):
  43:         return normalized
  44:     return json.dumps(normalized, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
  45: 
  46: 
  47: def _stable_sort_key(value: Any) -> str:
  48:     normalized = _normalize_for_json(value)
  49:     return json.dumps(normalized, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
  50: 
  51: 
  52: def _normalize_for_json(value: Any, _stack: set[int] | None = None) -> Any:
  53:     if _stack is None:
  54:         _stack = set()
  55: 
  56:     if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, bool)):
  57:         return value
  58:     if isinstance(value, float):
  59:         if math.isfinite(value):
  60:             return value
  61:         return {"__type__": "builtins.float", "value": repr(value)}
  62:     if isinstance(value, Path):
  63:         return str(value)
  64:     if isinstance(value, bytes):
  65:         return {"__type__": "builtins.bytes", "base64": base64.b64encode(value).decode("ascii")}
  66:     if isinstance(value, bytearray):
  67:         return {"__type__": "builtins.bytearray", "base64": base64.b64encode(bytes(value)).decode("ascii")}
  68:     if isinstance(value, memoryview):
  69:         return {"__type__": "builtins.memoryview", "base64": base64.b64encode(value.tobytes()).decode("ascii")}
  70:     if isinstance(value, SimpleNamespace):
  71:         marker = id(value)
  72:         if marker in _stack:
  73:             return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "cycle": True}
  74:         _stack.add(marker)
  75:         try:
  76:             fields_map = {key: _normalize_for_json(val, _stack) for key, val in vars(value).items()}
  77:             return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "fields": fields_map}
  78:         finally:
  79:             _stack.remove(marker)
  80:     if is_dataclass(value) and not isinstance(value, type):
  81:         marker = id(value)
  82:         if marker in _stack:
  83:             return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "cycle": True}
  84:         _stack.add(marker)
  85:         try:
  86:             fields_map = {}
  87:             for field in fields(value):
  88:                 fields_map[field.name] = _normalize_for_json(getattr(value, field.name), _stack)
  89:             return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "fields": fields_map}
  90:         finally:
  91:             _stack.remove(marker)
  92:     if isinstance(value, Mapping):
  93:         marker = id(value)
  94:         if marker in _stack:
  95:             return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "cycle": True}
  96:         _stack.add(marker)
  97:         try:
  98:             items: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
  99:             for key, item in value.items():
 100:                 items.append((_normalize_key(key), _normalize_for_json(item, _stack)))
 101:             items.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0])
 102:             return {key: item for key, item in items}
 103:         finally:
 104:             _stack.remove(marker)
 105:     if isinstance(value, tuple):
 106:         marker = id(value)
 107:         if marker in _stack:
 108:             return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "cycle": True}
 109:         _stack.add(marker)
 110:         try:
 111:             return [_normalize_for_json(item, _stack) for item in value]
 112:         finally:
 113:             _stack.remove(marker)
 114:     if isinstance(value, list):
 115:         marker = id(value)
 116:         if marker in _stack:
 117:             return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "cycle": True}
 118:         _stack.add(marker)
 119:         try:
 120:             return [_normalize_for_json(item, _stack) for item in value]
 121:         finally:
 122:             _stack.remove(marker)
 123:     if isinstance(value, set):
 124:         marker = id(value)
 125:         if marker in _stack:
 126:             return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "cycle": True}
 127:         _stack.add(marker)
 128:         try:
 129:             normalized_items = [_normalize_for_json(item, _stack) for item in value]
 130:             normalized_items.sort(key=_stable_sort_key)
 131:             return normalized_items
 132:         finally:
 133:             _stack.remove(marker)
 134:     if hasattr(value, "__dict__") and vars(value):
 135:         marker = id(value)
 136:         if marker in _stack:
 137:             return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "cycle": True}
 138:         _stack.add(marker)
 139:         try:
 140:             fields_map = {key: _normalize_for_json(val, _stack) for key, val in vars(value).items()}
 141:             return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "fields": fields_map}
 142:         finally:
 143:             _stack.remove(marker)
 144:     return {"__type__": _type_name(value), "repr": repr(value)}
 145: 
 146: 
 147: def _label_for_path(value: Any) -> str:
 148:     if isinstance(value, str):
 149:         return value
 150:     if isinstance(value, Path):
 151:         return str(value)
 152:     if isinstance(value, Mapping):
 153:         for key in ("name", "tool", "tool_name", "action"):
 154:             raw = value.get(key)
 155:             if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.strip():
 156:                 return raw
 157:         return json.dumps(_normalize_for_json(value), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
 158:     if isinstance(value, SimpleNamespace):
 159:         for key in ("name", "tool", "tool_name", "action"):
 160:             raw = getattr(value, key, None)
 161:             if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.strip():
 162:                 return raw
 163:         return json.dumps(_normalize_for_json(value), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
 164:     if hasattr(value, "name"):
 165:         raw = getattr(value, "name")
 166:         if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.strip():
 167:             return raw
 168:     return str(value)
 169:

 171: def _write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
 172:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 173:     path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
 174: 
 175: 
 176: def _write_bytes(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:
 177:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 178:     path.write_bytes(data)
 179: 
 180: 
 181: def _write_json(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
 182:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 183:     path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")

 186: @dataclass
 187: class ReceiptWriter:
 188:     """Write per-step receipts and raw payloads beneath a private audit root."""
 189: 
 190:     root: Path
 191: 
 192:     def __post_init__(self) -> None:
 193:         self.root = Path(self.root)
 194:         self.receipts_dir = self.root / "receipts"
 195:         self.raw_dir = self.root / "raw"
 196:         self.receipts_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 197:         self.raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 198: 
 199:     def record_step(self, step_idx: int, request: Any, response: Any, action: Any, raw_output: Any) -> Path:
 200:         action_name = _safe_action_name(action)
 201:         receipt_id = f"{step_idx:04d}_action_{action_name}"
 202:         receipt_path = self.receipts_dir / f"{receipt_id}.json"
 203:         raw_step_dir = self.raw_dir / receipt_id
 204: 
 205:         def write_raw_value(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
 206:             if value is None:
 207:                 _write_text(path, "")
 208:                 return
 209:             if isinstance(value, bytes):
 210:                 _write_bytes(path, value)
 211:                 return
 212:             if isinstance(value, bytearray):
 213:                 _write_bytes(path, bytes(value))
 214:                 return
 215:             if isinstance(value, memoryview):
 216:                 _write_bytes(path, value.tobytes())
 217:                 return
 218:             if isinstance(value, str):
 219:                 _write_text(path, value)
 220:                 return
 221:             if isinstance(value, Path):
 222:                 _write_text(path, str(value))
 223:                 return
 224:             if isinstance(value, (int, bool)) or (isinstance(value, float) and math.isfinite(value)):
 225:                 _write_text(path, str(value))
 226:                 return
 227:             _write_text(path, json.dumps(_normalize_for_json(value), indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False))
 228: 
 229:         raw_payload: dict[str, Any]
 230:         if isinstance(raw_output, Mapping):
 231:             raw_payload = {}
 232:             for key, value in raw_output.items():
 233:                 normalized_key = _normalize_key(key)
 234:                 raw_payload[normalized_key] = value
 235:                 write_raw_value(raw_step_dir / _safe_action_name(normalized_key), value)
 236:         else:
 237:             raw_payload = {"output": raw_output}
 238:             write_raw_value(raw_step_dir / "output", raw_output)
 239: 
 240:         payload = {
 241:             "action": _normalize_for_json(action),
 242:             "raw_output": _normalize_for_json(raw_payload),
 243:             "receipt_id": receipt_id,
 244:             "request": _normalize_for_json(request),
 245:             "response": _normalize_for_json(response),
 246:             "step": step_idx,
 247:         }
 248:         _write_json(receipt_path, payload)
 249:         return receipt_path
 250: 
 251:     def record_model_exchange(self, call_idx: int, request_messages: list[Any], response: Any) -> Path:
 252:         """Write a full-fidelity model exchange (request messages + response) for trace forensics.
 253: 
 254:         Model-invisible: writes ``model_exchange_<N>.json`` beneath the receipts root, capturing
 255:         the complete `request_messages` list verbatim plus the full response text and tool calls.
 256:         """
 257:         receipt_path = self.receipts_dir / f"model_exchange_{call_idx}.json"
 258:         response_text = getattr(response, "text", None)
 259:         response_tool_calls = getattr(response, "tool_calls", None)
 260:         payload = {

  35: def _pid_alive(pid: int) -> bool:
  36:     try:
  37:         os.kill(pid, 0)
  38:     except ProcessLookupError:
  39:         return False
  40:     except PermissionError:
  41:         return True
  42:     return True

  45: @dataclass(frozen=True)
  46: class FileDelta:

  53: @dataclass(frozen=True)
  54: class StateSnapshot:
  55:     workspace_root: str
  56:     captured_at: float
  57:     files: dict[str, str]
  58:     artifact_registry: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
  59:     service_registry: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
  60:     process_registry: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
  61:     job_registry: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
  62:     session_registry: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
  63:     # Cumulative, run-level facts that are NOT derivable from a single filesystem
  64:     # snapshot: package-manager command successes and nonzero-exit commands seen
  65:     # so far. Populated externally (loop.py / ExecutionContext) via
  66:     # dataclasses.replace(); defaulted to empty here so plain snapshot()/diff()
  67:     # callers are unaffected.
  68:     installed_packages: tuple[str, ...] = ()
  69:     nonzero_exits: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...] = ()

  74:     workspace_root: str
  75:     captured_at: float
  76:     files_changed: list[FileDelta]
  77:     artifact_registry_changed: bool
  78:     service_registry_changed: bool
  79:     process_registry_changed: bool
  80:     job_registry_changed: bool
  81:     session_registry_changed: bool

  83:     modified_paths: tuple[str, ...]
  84:     deleted_paths: tuple[str, ...]
  85: 
  86:     @property
  87:     def is_empty(self) -> bool:
  88:         return not self.files_changed and not any(
  89:             (
  90:                 self.artifact_registry_changed,
  91:                 self.service_registry_changed,
  92:                 self.process_registry_changed,
  93:                 self.job_registry_changed,
  94:                 self.session_registry_changed,
  95:             )

  99: def snapshot(workspace_root: Path) -> StateSnapshot:
 100:     """Capture a conservative workspace snapshot from visible files and local registries."""
 101: 
 102:     root = workspace_root.resolve(strict=False)
 103:     files: dict[str, str] = {}
 104:     artifact_registry: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
 105: 
 106:     for path in _iter_visible_files(root):
 107:         relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
 108:         files[relative] = _sha256_file(path)
 109:         artifact_registry[relative] = build_artifact_record(
 110:             path=relative,
 111:             workspace_root=root,
 112:             generated=None,
 113:         )
 114: 
 115:     return StateSnapshot(
 116:         workspace_root=root.as_posix(),
 117:         captured_at=time.time(),
 118:         files=files,
 119:         artifact_registry=artifact_registry,
 120:         service_registry=_load_registry(root, "service_registry"),
 121:         process_registry=_load_registry(root, "process_registry"),
 122:         job_registry=_load_job_registry(root),
 123:         session_registry=_load_session_registry(root),
 124:     )
 125: 
 126: 
 127: def diff(prev: StateSnapshot, curr: StateSnapshot) -> DeltaReport:
 128:     """Compare two snapshots and return the file and registry deltas."""
 129: 
 130:     prev_files = dict(prev.files)
 131:     curr_files = dict(curr.files)
 132:     file_paths = sorted(set(prev_files) | set(curr_files))
 133:     file_deltas: list[FileDelta] = []
 134:     added_paths: list[str] = []
 135:     modified_paths: list[str] = []
 136:     deleted_paths: list[str] = []
 137: 
 138:     for path in file_paths:
 139:         before = prev_files.get(path)
 140:         after = curr_files.get(path)
 141:         if before == after:
 142:             continue
 143:         if before is None:
 144:             file_deltas.append(FileDelta(path=path, hash_before=None, hash_after=after, change_type="added"))
 145:             added_paths.append(path)
 146:         elif after is None:
 147:             file_deltas.append(FileDelta(path=path, hash_before=before, hash_after=None, change_type="deleted"))
 148:             deleted_paths.append(path)
 149:         else:
 150:             file_deltas.append(FileDelta(path=path, hash_before=before, hash_after=after, change_type="modified"))
 151:             modified_paths.append(path)
 152: 
 153:     return DeltaReport(
 154:         workspace_root=curr.workspace_root,
 155:         captured_at=curr.captured_at,
 156:         files_changed=file_deltas,
 157:         artifact_registry_changed=prev.artifact_registry != curr.artifact_registry,
 158:         service_registry_changed=prev.service_registry != curr.service_registry,
 159:         process_registry_changed=prev.process_registry != curr.process_registry,
 160:         job_registry_changed=prev.job_registry != curr.job_registry,
 161:         session_registry_changed=prev.session_registry != curr.session_registry,
 162:         added_paths=tuple(added_paths),
 163:         modified_paths=tuple(modified_paths),
 164:         deleted_paths=tuple(deleted_paths),
 165:     )
 166: 
 167: 
 168: def _iter_visible_files(workspace_root: Path):
 169:     for path in sorted(workspace_root.rglob("*")):
 170:         if not path.is_file():
 171:             continue
 172:         if any(part in _IGNORED_DIR_NAMES for part in path.parts):
 173:             continue
 174:         yield path
 175: 
 176: 
 177: def _load_registry(workspace_root: Path, registry_name: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
 178:     candidates = [workspace_root / f"{filename}" for filename in _REGISTRY_FILENAMES[registry_name]]
 179:     candidates.extend(
 180:         workspace_root / ".aether2" / "state" / f"{filename}"
 181:         for filename in _REGISTRY_FILENAMES[registry_name]
 182:     )
 183:     for candidate in candidates:
 184:         if not candidate.exists() or not candidate.is_file():
 185:             continue
 186:         try:
 187:             data = json.loads(candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 188:         except Exception:
 189:             continue
 190:         if isinstance(data, dict):
 191:             return {
 192:                 str(key): dict(value) if isinstance(value, dict) else {}
 193:                 for key, value in data.items()
 194:                 if isinstance(key, str) and key
 195:             }
 196:     return {}
 197: 
 198: 
 199: def _load_job_registry(workspace_root: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
 200:     jobs_dir = workspace_root / ".aether2" / "state" / "jobs"
 201:     if not jobs_dir.exists():
 202:         return _load_registry(workspace_root, "job_registry")
 203:     jobs: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
 204:     for meta_path in sorted(jobs_dir.glob("*/meta.json")):
 205:         try:
 206:             data = json.loads(meta_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 207:         except Exception:
 208:             continue
 209:         job_id = str(data.get("job_id") or meta_path.parent.name).strip()
 210:         if not job_id:
 211:             continue
 212:         log_path = Path(str(data.get("log_path") or meta_path.parent / "job.log"))
 213:         exit_code_path = Path(str(data.get("exit_code_path") or meta_path.parent / "exit_code"))
 214:         pid = int(data.get("pid") or 0)
 215:         exit_code = None
 216:         if exit_code_path.exists():
 217:             try:
 218:                 exit_code = int(exit_code_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip())
 219:             except ValueError:
 220:                 exit_code = None
 221:         jobs[job_id] = {
 222:             "pid": pid,
 223:             "cwd": str(data.get("cwd") or ""),
 224:             "alive": _pid_alive(pid) if pid > 0 and exit_code is None else False,
 225:             "exit_code": exit_code,
 226:             "log_path": str(log_path),
 227:             "log_size": log_path.stat().st_size if log_path.exists() else 0,
 228:             "registry_path": str(meta_path),
 229:         }
 230:     if jobs:
 231:         return jobs
 232:     return _load_registry(workspace_root, "job_registry")
 233: 
 234: 
 235: def _load_session_registry(workspace_root: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
 236:     sessions_dir = workspace_root / ".aether2" / "state" / "sessions"
 237:     if not sessions_dir.exists():
 238:         return _load_registry(workspace_root, "session_registry")
 239:     sessions: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
 240:     for path in sorted(sessions_dir.glob("*.json")):
 241:         try:
 242:             data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 243:         except Exception:
 244:             continue
 245:         session_id = str(data.get("session_id") or path.stem).strip()
 246:         if not session_id:
 247:             continue
 248:         sessions[session_id] = {
 249:             "command": str(data.get("command") or ""),
 250:             "registry_path": str(path),
 251:         }
 252:     if sessions:
 253:         return sessions
 254:     return _load_registry(workspace_root, "session_registry")

  33: class JobRegistry:
  34:     """Detached job registry. Jobs are launched through `backend` (C1): when
  35:     `backend.kind == "local"` (the default), the wrapper script is spawned on
  36:     the host exactly as before. When `backend.kind == "docker"`, the wrapper
  37:     script is launched INSIDE the task container via `docker exec -d
  38:     setsid ...`, so containerized tasks' services/jobs run where the agent
  39:     (and the verifier) actually live, not on the host. Pidfiles/logfiles/
  40:     registry state always live under `state_dir` (the task workspace's
  41:     `.aether2/state` dir), which is bind-mounted into the container, so
  42:     `status()` reads container truth either way.
  43:     """
  44: 
  45:     def __init__(self, state_dir: Path, *, backend: ContainerBackend | None = None, container_path_fn=None) -> None:
  46:         self.state_dir = state_dir.resolve()
  47:         self.jobs_dir = self.state_dir / "jobs"
  48:         self.jobs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  49:         self.backend = backend or ContainerBackend()
  50:         # Maps a host path to its in-container path string (required when
  51:         # backend.kind != "local"); injected by the caller (ExecutionContext),
  52:         # which already knows the workspace-root mapping.
  53:         self._container_path_fn = container_path_fn
  54:

  56:         command = str(cmd).strip()
  57:         if not command:
  58:             raise ValueError("start requires a non-empty command")
  59:         resolved_job_id = job_id or f"job-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
  60:         job_dir = self.jobs_dir / resolved_job_id
  61:         job_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  62:         cwd_path = Path(cwd or self.state_dir.parent).resolve()
  63:         log_path = job_dir / "job.log"
  64:         exit_code_path = job_dir / "exit_code"
  65:         wrapper_path = job_dir / "run.sh"

  75:                     (
  76:                         "trap 'status=$?; "

 108:                 {
 109:                     "job_id": resolved_job_id,
 110:                     "cmd": command,
 111:                     "cwd": str(cwd_path),
 112:                     "pid": pid,
 113:                     "log_path": str(log_path),
 114:                     "registry_path": str(meta_path),
 115:                     "exit_code_path": str(exit_code_path),
 116:                     "backend_kind": self.backend.kind,
 117:                 },
 118:                 indent=2,
 119:                 sort_keys=True,
 120:             )
 121:             + "\n",
 122:             encoding="utf-8",
 123:         )
 124:         return resolved_job_id
 125: 
 126:     def _start_in_container(self, wrapper_path: Path, job_dir: Path) -> int:
 127:         """Launch `wrapper_path` detached INSIDE the container (C1).
 128: 
 129:         Runs `docker exec <container> setsid <wrapper> & echo $!` via the
 130:         container's shell so the launched process is reparented to the
 131:         container's init and survives the agent process tree exiting, and
 132:         prints its in-container PID to stdout for liveness checks.
 133:         """
 134:         if self.backend.kind != "docker":
 135:             raise RuntimeError(f"unsupported non-local backend kind: {self.backend.kind!r}")
 136:         if not self.backend.container_id:
 137:             raise RuntimeError("docker backend requires a container_id")
 138:         if self._container_path_fn is None:
 139:             raise RuntimeError("docker backend requires a container_path_fn to map host paths into the container")
 140:         container_wrapper = self._container_path_fn(wrapper_path)
 141:         exec_cmd = [
 142:             "docker",
 143:             "exec",
 144:             self.backend.container_id,
 145:             self.backend.exec_shell,
 146:             "-c",
 147:             f"setsid {shlex.quote(container_wrapper)} </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $!",
 148:         ]
 149:         completed = subprocess.run(exec_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
 150:         if completed.returncode != 0:
 151:             raise RuntimeError(f"failed to launch in-container job: {completed.stderr.strip()}")
 152:         pid_text = (completed.stdout or "").strip().splitlines()[-1] if completed.stdout else ""
 153:         try:
 154:             return int(pid_text)
 155:         except ValueError:
 156:             raise RuntimeError(f"failed to parse in-container job pid from output: {completed.stdout!r}")
 157: 
 158:     def _pid_alive_for_backend(self, pid: int) -> bool:
 159:         if self.backend.kind == "local":
 160:             return _pid_alive(pid)
 161:         if not self.backend.container_id:
 162:             return False
 163:         completed = subprocess.run(
 164:             ["docker", "exec", self.backend.container_id, "kill", "-0", str(pid)],
 165:             capture_output=True,
 166:             text=True,
 167:             check=False,
 168:         )
 169:         return completed.returncode == 0
 170: 
 171:     def status(self, job_id: str) -> JobStatus:
 172:         meta_path = self.jobs_dir / job_id / "meta.json"
 173:         if not meta_path.exists():
 174:             raise KeyError(f"unknown job: {job_id}")
 175:         data = json.loads(meta_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 176:         pid = int(data["pid"])
 177:         exit_code_path = Path(data["exit_code_path"])
 178:         exit_code = _read_exit_code(exit_code_path)
 179:         process_alive = self._pid_alive_for_backend(pid)
 180:         if exit_code is None and not process_alive:
 181:             # The launcher process was terminated (e.g. by an external signal)
 182:             # before it could record its own exit status. Report a truthful,
 183:             # generic "terminated externally" code rather than leaving the
 184:             # job stuck in an "alive" state forever.
 185:             exit_code = 143
 186:         alive = exit_code is None and process_alive
 187:         return JobStatus(
 188:             job_id=job_id,
 189:             pid=pid,
 190:             alive=alive,
 191:             exit_code=exit_code,
 192:             cwd=str(data["cwd"]),
 193:             log_path=str(data["log_path"]),
 194:             tail=_read_tail(Path(data["log_path"])),
 195:             registry_path=str(meta_path),
 196:         )
 197: 
 198:     def as_dict(self, job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 199:         return asdict(self.status(job_id))
 200: 
 201: 
 202: def _pid_alive(pid: int) -> bool:
 203:     try:
 204:         os.kill(pid, 0)
 205:     except ProcessLookupError:
 206:         return False
 207:     except PermissionError:
 208:         return True
 209:     return True
 210: 
 211: 
 212: def _read_exit_code(path: Path) -> int | None:
 213:     if not path.exists():
 214:         return None
 215:     try:
 216:         return int(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip())
 217:     except ValueError:
 218:         return None
 219: 
 220: 
 221: def _read_tail(path: Path) -> str:
 222:     if not path.exists():
 223:         return ""
 224:     data = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
 225:     return data[-TAIL_LIMIT:]

===== runner/aether2/sessions.py =====
   1: """Tmux-backed session registry for persistent PTY interaction."""
   2: 
   3: from __future__ import annotations
   4: 
   5: from dataclasses import dataclass
   6: from pathlib import Path
   7: import json
   8: import shutil
   9: import subprocess
  10: 
  11: from runner.aether2.executor import ContainerBackend
  12: 
  13: 
  14: @dataclass(frozen=True)
  15: class SessionRecord:
  16:     session_id: str
  17:     command: str
  18:     registry_path: str
  19: 
  20: 
  21: class SessionRegistry:
  22:     """Tmux-backed session registry (C1).
  23: 
  24:     When `backend.kind == "local"` (the default), `tmux` is invoked on the
  25:     host exactly as before. When `backend.kind == "docker"`, every `tmux`
  26:     invocation is routed through `docker exec <container> tmux ...` so the
  27:     PTY session lives inside the task container, where the agent and verifier
  28:     run. If `tmux` is unavailable in-container, callers get a truthful error
  29:     (the same `RuntimeError("tmux is unavailable")` as the local case).
  30:     """
  31: 
  32:     def __init__(self, state_dir: Path, *, backend: ContainerBackend | None = None) -> None:
  33:         self.state_dir = state_dir.resolve()
  34:         self.sessions_dir = self.state_dir / "sessions"
  35:         self.sessions_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  36:         self.backend = backend or ContainerBackend()
  37: 
  38:     def start(self, session_id: str, command: str) -> str:
  39:         self._require_tmux()
  40:         path = self.sessions_dir / f"{session_id}.json"
  41:         if path.exists():
  42:             raise ValueError(f"session already exists: {session_id}")
  43:         self._tmux("new-session", "-d", "-s", session_id, command)
  44:         record = SessionRecord(
  45:             session_id=session_id,
  46:             command=command,
  47:             registry_path=str(path),
  48:         )
  49:         path.write_text(
  50:             json.dumps(record.__dict__, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
  51:             encoding="utf-8",
  52:         )
  53:         return session_id
  54: 
  55:     def send(self, session_id: str, keys: str) -> None:
  56:         self._require_tmux()
  57:         self._load(session_id)
  58:         self._tmux("send-keys", "-t", session_id, keys)
  59: 
  60:     def read(self, session_id: str) -> str:
  61:         self._require_tmux()
  62:         self._load(session_id)
  63:         try:
  64:             result = self._tmux("capture-pane", "-p", "-t", session_id)
  65:         except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
  66:             stderr = (exc.stderr or "").strip()
  67:             if "can't find" in stderr.lower() or "no such" in stderr.lower():
  68:                 return ""
  69:             raise
  70:         return result.stdout
  71: 
  72:     def stop(self, session_id: str) -> None:
  73:         """Kill the underlying tmux session and remove it from the registry, if present."""
  74:         self._require_tmux()
  75:         path = self.sessions_dir / f"{session_id}.json"
  76:         if not path.exists():
  77:             raise KeyError(f"unknown session: {session_id}")
  78:         try:
  79:             self._tmux("kill-session", "-t", session_id)
  80:         except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
  81:             stderr = (exc.stderr or "").strip()
  82:             if "can't find" not in stderr.lower() and "no such" not in stderr.lower():
  83:                 raise
  84:         path.unlink()
  85: 
  86:     def list_session_ids(self) -> list[str]:
  87:         return sorted(path.stem for path in self.sessions_dir.glob("*.json"))
  88: 
  89:     def _load(self, session_id: str) -> SessionRecord:
  90:         path = self.sessions_dir / f"{session_id}.json"
  91:         if not path.exists():
  92:             raise KeyError(f"unknown session: {session_id}")
  93:         data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
  94:         return SessionRecord(
  95:             session_id=str(data["session_id"]),
  96:             command=str(data["command"]),
  97:             registry_path=str(path),
  98:         )
  99: 
 100:     def _require_tmux(self) -> str:
 101:         if self.backend.kind != "local":
 102:             # Existence is checked by actually invoking tmux in-container
 103:             # (see _tmux); we cannot probe PATH from the host.
 104:             return "tmux"
 105:         tmux = shutil.which("tmux")
 106:         if not tmux:
 107:             raise RuntimeError("tmux is unavailable")
 108:         return tmux
 109: 
 110:     def _tmux(self, *args: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
 111:         tmux = self._require_tmux()
 112:         if self.backend.kind == "local":
 113:             command = [tmux, *args]
 114:         else:
 115:             if not self.backend.container_id:
 116:                 raise RuntimeError("docker backend requires a container_id")
 117:             command = ["docker", "exec", self.backend.container_id, "tmux", *args]
 118:         try:
 119:             return subprocess.run(
 120:                 command,
 121:                 check=True,
 122:                 text=True,
 123:                 capture_output=True,
 124:             )
 125:         except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
 126:             stderr = (exc.stderr or "")
 127:             if self.backend.kind != "local" and (
 128:                 "executable file not found" in stderr.lower() or "tmux: not found" in stderr.lower() or "no such file or directory" in stderr.lower()
 129:             ):
 130:                 raise RuntimeError("tmux is unavailable") from exc
 131:             raise
 132:

   1: """Continuous executor loop composing tools, context, mirror, and verification into one run."""

  31: STEP_CAP = 120
  32: MAX_VERIFICATION_ROUNDS = 3
  33: CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS = 128_000
  34: 
  35: # Generic package-manager invocations (first 1-2 shell tokens). Used only to
  36: # detect "this run_command was a package install" for the §6.5 fact ledger's
  37: # `installed_packages` entry -- no task-specific package names or logic.
  38: _PACKAGE_MANAGER_PREFIXES: tuple[tuple[str, ...], ...] = (
  39:     ("apt-get", "install"),
  40:     ("apt", "install"),
  41:     ("pip", "install"),
  42:     ("pip3", "install"),
  43:     ("python", "-m", "pip", "install"),
  44:     ("python3", "-m", "pip", "install"),
  45:     ("npm", "install"),
  46:     ("npm", "i"),
  47:     ("yarn", "add"),
  48:     ("cargo", "install"),
  49:     ("gem", "install"),
  50:     ("go", "install"),
  51:     ("brew", "install"),
  52:     ("conda", "install"),
  53:     ("apk", "add"),
  54:     ("dnf", "install"),
  55:     ("yum", "install"),
  56: )
  57: 
  58: 
  59: def _is_package_manager_install(command: str) -> bool:
  60:     try:
  61:         tokens = shlex.split(command, posix=True)
  62:     except ValueError:
  63:         return False
  64:     for prefix in _PACKAGE_MANAGER_PREFIXES:
  65:         if tuple(tokens[: len(prefix)]) == prefix:
  66:             return True
  67:     return False
  68:

 109: 
 110: class ExecutionContext:
 111:     """Adapts the container executor, job registry, and session registry to the dispatch surface."""
 112: 
 113:     def __init__(
 114:         self,
 115:         *,
 116:         executor: ContainerExecutor,
 117:         job_registry: JobRegistry,
 118:         session_registry: SessionRegistry,
 119:         raw_log_dir: Path,
 120:     ) -> None:
 121:         self.executor = executor
 122:         self.job_registry = job_registry
 123:         self.session_registry = session_registry
 124:         self.raw_log_dir = raw_log_dir
 125:         self.workspace_root = executor.workspace_root
 126:         self.last_snapshot: StateSnapshot = delta_snapshot(self.workspace_root)
 127:         self.last_delta_report = delta_diff(self.last_snapshot, self.last_snapshot)
 128:         # Cumulative run-level facts for the §6.5 fact ledger (not derivable from
 129:         # a single filesystem snapshot).
 130:         self.installed_packages: list[str] = []
 131:         self.nonzero_exits: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
 132: 
 133:     def run_command(self, cmd: str, timeout_sec: int = 120, cwd: str | None = None) -> ObservationEnvelope:
 134:         raw = self.executor.run(cmd, timeout_sec=timeout_sec, cwd=cwd)
 135:         exit_code = getattr(raw, "exit_code", None)
 136:         if exit_code == 0 and _is_package_manager_install(cmd):
 137:             self.installed_packages.append(cmd)
 138:         elif exit_code is not None and exit_code != 0:
 139:             self.nonzero_exits.append({"command": cmd, "exit_code": exit_code, "stderr": (getattr(raw, "stderr", "") or "")[-2048:]})
 140:         return self._observe_raw(raw)
 141: 
 142:     def start_job(self, cmd: str, job_id: str | None = None, cwd: str | None = None) -> ObservationEnvelope:
 143:         started_at = time.monotonic()
 144:         try:
 145:             resolved_job_id = self.job_registry.start(cmd, job_id=job_id, cwd=cwd)
 146:             status = self.job_registry.status(resolved_job_id)
 147:             raw = {
 148:                 "tool": "start_job",
 149:                 "exit_code": 0,
 150:                 "duration_sec": time.monotonic() - started_at,
 151:                 "cwd": status.cwd,
 152:                 "stdout": f"started job {resolved_job_id} (pid {status.pid})",
 153:                 "stderr": "",
 154:             }
 155:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surfaced as a truthful error envelope
 156:             raw = _error_raw("start_job", exc, started_at=started_at, cwd=str(self.executor.workspace_root))
 157:         return self._observe_raw(raw)
 158: 
 159:     def job_status(self, job_id: str) -> ObservationEnvelope:
 160:         started_at = time.monotonic()
 161:         try:
 162:             status = self.job_registry.status(job_id)
 163:             raw = {
 164:                 "tool": "job_status",
 165:                 "exit_code": status.exit_code if status.exit_code is not None else (0 if status.alive else None),
 166:                 "duration_sec": time.monotonic() - started_at,
 167:                 "cwd": status.cwd,
 168:                 "stdout": (
 169:                     f"job {job_id}: alive={status.alive} exit_code={status.exit_code}\n--- log tail ---\n{status.tail}"
 170:                 ),
 171:                 "stderr": "",
 172:             }
 173:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
 174:             raw = _error_raw("job_status", exc, started_at=started_at, cwd=str(self.executor.workspace_root))
 175:         return self._observe_raw(raw)
 176:

 189:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001

 191:         return self._observe_raw(raw)
 192: 
 193:     def session_send(self, session_id: str, keys: str) -> ObservationEnvelope:
 194:         started_at = time.monotonic()
 195:         try:
 196:             self.session_registry.send(session_id, keys)
 197:             raw = {
 198:                 "tool": "session_send",
 199:                 "exit_code": 0,
 200:                 "duration_sec": time.monotonic() - started_at,
 201:                 "cwd": str(self.executor.workspace_root),
 202:                 "stdout": f"sent keys to session {session_id}",
 203:                 "stderr": "",
 204:             }
 205:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
 206:             raw = _error_raw("session_send", exc, started_at=started_at, cwd=str(self.executor.workspace_root))
 207:         return self._observe_raw(raw)
 208: 
 209:     def session_read(self, session_id: str) -> ObservationEnvelope:
 210:         started_at = time.monotonic()
 211:         try:
 212:             screen = self.session_registry.read(session_id)
 213:             raw = {
 214:                 "tool": "session_read",
 215:                 "exit_code": None,
 216:                 "duration_sec": time.monotonic() - started_at,
 217:                 "cwd": str(self.executor.workspace_root),
 218:                 "stdout": screen,
 219:                 "stderr": "",
 220:             }
 221:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
 222:             raw = _error_raw("session_read", exc, started_at=started_at, cwd=str(self.executor.workspace_root))
 223:         return self._observe_raw(raw)
 224: 
 225:     def read_file(self, path: str, offset: int | None = None, limit: int | None = None) -> ObservationEnvelope:
 226:         started_at = time.monotonic()
 227:         try:
 228:             target = self.executor.resolve_workspace_path(path)
 229:             text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
 230:             lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
 231:             start = offset or 0
 232:             if limit is not None:
 233:                 selected = lines[start : start + limit]
 234:             else:
 235:                 selected = lines[start:]
 236:             content = "".join(selected)
 237:             truncated_note = ""
 238:             if start > 0 or (limit is not None and start + limit < len(lines)):
 239:                 truncated_note = f"\n...[showing lines {start}:{start + len(selected)} of {len(lines)}]"
 240:             raw = {
 241:                 "tool": "read_file",
 242:                 "exit_code": 0,
 243:                 "duration_sec": time.monotonic() - started_at,
 244:                 "cwd": str(self.executor.workspace_root),
 245:                 "stdout": content + truncated_note,
 246:                 "stderr": "",
 247:             }
 248:         except ValueError as exc:
 249:             raw = _error_raw(
 250:                 "read_file",
 251:                 exc,
 252:                 started_at=started_at,
 253:                 cwd=str(self.executor.workspace_root),
 254:                 kind="workspace_boundary_violation",
 255:             )
 256:         except FileNotFoundError as exc:
 257:             raw = _error_raw("read_file", exc, started_at=started_at, cwd=str(self.executor.workspace_root), kind="file_not_found")
 258:         except OSError as exc:
 259:             raw = _error_raw("read_file", exc, started_at=started_at, cwd=str(self.executor.workspace_root), kind="io_error")
 260:         return self._observe_raw(raw)

===== runner/aether2/mirror.py =====
   1: """No-delta progress mirror for Aether-2."""
   2: 
   3: from __future__ import annotations
   4: 
   5: from dataclasses import dataclass
   6: 
   7: from runner.aether2.delta import DeltaReport
   8: 
   9: __all__ = ["Mirror", "MirrorNote"]
  10: 
  11: 
  12: @dataclass(frozen=True)
  13: class MirrorNote:
  14:     """Factual no-delta observation surfaced to the model."""
  15: 
  16:     action_signature: str
  17:     streak: int
  18:     text: str
  19:     fuel_gauge_text: str | None = None
  20:     note_type: str = "no_delta_progress"
  21: 
  22: 
  23: class Mirror:
  24:     """Track identical zero-delta streaks and emit factual observations."""
  25: 
  26:     def __init__(self) -> None:
  27:         self._last_action_signature: str | None = None
  28:         self._streak = 0
  29: 
  30:     @property
  31:     def streak(self) -> int:
  32:         return self._streak
  33: 
  34:     def observe(
  35:         self,
  36:         action_signature: str,
  37:         delta: DeltaReport,
  38:         *,
  39:         established_facts: list[str] | None = None,
  40:         unused_affordances: list[str] | None = None,
  41:         fuel_gauge_text: str | None = None,
  42:     ) -> MirrorNote | None:
  43:         if action_signature != self._last_action_signature:
  44:             self._last_action_signature = action_signature
  45:             self._streak = 0
  46: 
  47:         if not delta.is_empty:
  48:             self._streak = 0
  49:             return None
  50: 
  51:         self._streak += 1
  52:         if self._streak == 3:
  53:             return self._build_note(
  54:                 include_fuel_gauge=False,
  55:                 established_facts=established_facts or [],
  56:                 unused_affordances=unused_affordances or [],
  57:                 fuel_gauge_text=fuel_gauge_text,
  58:             )
  59:         if self._streak == 6:
  60:             return self._build_note(
  61:                 include_fuel_gauge=True,
  62:                 established_facts=established_facts or [],
  63:                 unused_affordances=unused_affordances or [],
  64:                 fuel_gauge_text=fuel_gauge_text,
  65:             )
  66:         return None
  67: 
  68:     def _build_note(
  69:         self,
  70:         *,
  71:         include_fuel_gauge: bool,
  72:         established_facts: list[str],
  73:         unused_affordances: list[str],
  74:         fuel_gauge_text: str | None,
  75:     ) -> MirrorNote:
  76:         facts_text = ", ".join(established_facts) if established_facts else "none recorded"
  77:         affordances_text = ", ".join(unused_affordances) if unused_affordances else "none recorded"
  78:         text = (
  79:             f"Steps in this streak produced no state change. "
  80:             f"Already established: {facts_text}. "
  81:             f"Not yet tried: {affordances_text}."
  82:         )
  83:         return MirrorNote(
  84:             action_signature="" if self._last_action_signature is None else self._last_action_signature,
  85:             streak=self._streak,
  86:             text=text,
  87:             fuel_gauge_text=(fuel_gauge_text or "elapsed/remaining time") if include_fuel_gauge else None,
  88:         )

  73: def collapse_cr_ansi(text: str) -> str:
  74:     """Collapse ANSI escape noise and carriage-return rewrites to the visible final state."""
  75:     if not text:
  76:         return text
  77:     without_ansi = _ANSI_RE.sub("", text)
  78:     normalized = without_ansi.replace("\r\n", "\n")
  79:     rendered_lines: list[str] = []
  80:     current: list[str] = []
  81:     for char in normalized:
  82:         if char == "\r":
  83:             current.clear()
  84:             continue
  85:         if char == "\n":
  86:             rendered_lines.append("".join(current))
  87:             rendered_lines.append("\n")
  88:             current.clear()
  89:             continue
  90:         current.append(char)
  91:     rendered_lines.append("".join(current))
  92:     return "".join(rendered_lines)
  93:

  95: def build_envelope(raw: Any, *, raw_log_dir: Path) -> ObservationEnvelope:
  96:     tool = str(_coerce_field(raw, "tool", "unknown"))
  97:     exit_code = _coerce_optional_int(_coerce_field(raw, "exit_code", None))
  98:     duration_sec = float(_coerce_field(raw, "duration_sec", _coerce_field(raw, "duration", 0.0)))
  99:     cwd = str(_coerce_field(raw, "cwd", os.getcwd()))
 100:     stdout = str(_coerce_field(raw, "stdout", _coerce_field(raw, "stdout_text", "")))
 101:     stderr = str(_coerce_field(raw, "stderr", _coerce_field(raw, "stderr_text", "")))
 102:     files_changed = _coerce_file_deltas(_coerce_field(raw, "files_changed", []))
 103:     process_delta = _coerce_process_delta(_coerce_field(raw, "process_delta", None))
 104:     error = _coerce_error_info(_coerce_field(raw, "error", None))
 105:     blind_retry_blocked = _coerce_blind_retry_blocked(raw, error)
 106: 
 107:     raw_log_dir = Path(raw_log_dir).resolve()
 108:     raw_log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 109:     raw_log_path = raw_log_dir / f"{_slugify(tool)}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}.json"
 110:     raw_payload = {
 111:         "tool": tool,
 112:         "exit_code": exit_code,
 113:         "duration_sec": duration_sec,
 114:         "cwd": cwd,
 115:         "stdout": stdout,
 116:         "stderr": stderr,
 117:         "files_changed": [asdict(file_delta) for file_delta in files_changed],
 118:         "process_delta": _process_delta_to_dict(process_delta),
 119:         "blind_retry_blocked": blind_retry_blocked,
 120:         "error": None if error is None else _error_info_to_dict(error),
 121:     }
 122:     raw_log_path.write_text(json.dumps(raw_payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
 123: 
 124:     stdout_clean = collapse_cr_ansi(stdout)
 125:     stderr_clean = collapse_cr_ansi(stderr)
 126:     stdout_head, stdout_tail, stdout_truncated = _bound_stream(stdout_clean)
 127:     stderr_head, stderr_tail, stderr_truncated = _bound_stream(stderr_clean)
 128: 
 129:     return ObservationEnvelope(
 130:         tool=tool,
 131:         exit_code=exit_code,
 132:         duration_sec=duration_sec,
 133:         cwd=cwd,
 134:         stdout_head=stdout_head,
 135:         stdout_tail=stdout_tail,
 136:         stderr_head=stderr_head,
 137:         stderr_tail=stderr_tail,
 138:         truncated=stdout_truncated or stderr_truncated,
 139:         raw_log_path=str(raw_log_path),
 140:         files_changed=files_changed,
 141:         process_delta=process_delta,
 142:         blind_retry_blocked=blind_retry_blocked,
 143:         error=error,
 144:     )
 145: 
 146: 
 147: def _bound_stream(text: str) -> tuple[str, str, bool]:
 148:     length = len(text)
 149:     if length <= _HEAD_TAIL_LIMIT:
 150:         return text, "", False
 151:     if length <= _FULL_BOUND_LIMIT:
 152:         return text[:_HEAD_TAIL_LIMIT], text[_HEAD_TAIL_LIMIT:], False
 153:     return text[:_HEAD_TAIL_LIMIT], text[-_HEAD_TAIL_LIMIT:], True
 154:

 156: def _coerce_field(raw: Any, name: str, default: Any) -> Any:
 157:     if isinstance(raw, Mapping) and name in raw:
 158:         return raw[name]
 159:     if hasattr(raw, name):
 160:         return getattr(raw, name)
 161:     return default
 162:

 164: def _coerce_optional_int(value: Any) -> int | None:
 165:     if value is None:
 166:         return None
 167:     return int(value)

 170: def _coerce_file_deltas(value: Any) -> list[FileDelta]:
 171:     if value is None:
 172:         return []
 173:     deltas: list[FileDelta] = []
 174:     for item in value:
 175:         if isinstance(item, FileDelta):
 176:             deltas.append(item)
 177:             continue
 178:         if isinstance(item, Mapping):
 179:             deltas.append(
 180:                 FileDelta(
 181:                     path=str(item.get("path", "")),
 182:                     hash_before=_optional_str(item.get("hash_before")),
 183:                     hash_after=_optional_str(item.get("hash_after")),
 184:                     change_type=str(item.get("change_type", "unknown")),
 185:                 )
 186:             )
 187:             continue
 188:         deltas.append(
 189:             FileDelta(
 190:                 path=str(getattr(item, "path", "")),
 191:                 hash_before=_optional_str(getattr(item, "hash_before", None)),
 192:                 hash_after=_optional_str(getattr(item, "hash_after", None)),
 193:                 change_type=str(getattr(item, "change_type", "unknown")),
 194:             )
 195:         )
 196:     return deltas

 214:             services_exited=[str(item) for item in value.get("services_exited", [])],
 215:             job_log_growth={
 216:                 str(key): int(val) for key, val in value.get("job_log_growth", {}).items()
 217:             },
 218:             session_log_growth={
 219:                 str(key): int(val) for key, val in value.get("session_log_growth", {}).items()

 235:         services_started=[str(item) for item in getattr(value, "services_started", [])],

 237:         job_log_growth={
 238:             str(key): int(val) for key, val in getattr(value, "job_log_growth", {}).items()

===== runner/aether2/metrics.py =====
   1: """Per-trial scorecard helpers for Aether-2."""

   3: from __future__ import annotations

  17:     tokens_fresh: int

  45:             "cache_hit_ratio": self.cache_hit_ratio,
  46:             "no_delta_streaks": self.no_delta_streaks,
  47:             "verification_rounds": self.verification_rounds,
  48:             "recoveries": self.recoveries,
  49:             "compaction_count": self.compaction_count,
  50:             "job_survival": self.job_survival,
  51:             "session_survival": self.session_survival,
  52:             "action_type_breakdown": dict(self.action_type_breakdown),

  56: def _get_value(run: Any, name: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
  57:     if isinstance(run, dict):
  58:         return run.get(name, default)
  59:     return getattr(run, name, default)
  60: 
  61: 
  62: def _record_value(record: Any, name: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
  63:     if isinstance(record, dict):
  64:         return record.get(name, default)
  65:     return getattr(record, name, default)
  66: 
  67: 
  68: def _get_int(run: Any, *names: str, default: int = 0) -> int:
  69:     for name in names:
  70:         value = _get_value(run, name, None)
  71:         if value is not None:
  72:             return int(value)
  73:     return default
  74: 
  75: 
  76: def _get_float(run: Any, *names: str, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
  77:     for name in names:
  78:         value = _get_value(run, name, None)
  79:         if value is not None:
  80:             return float(value)
  81:     return default
  82: 
  83: 
  84: def _get_bool(run: Any, *names: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:
  85:     for name in names:
  86:         value = _get_value(run, name, None)
  87:         if value is not None:
  88:             return bool(value)
  89:     return default
  90: 
  91: 
  92: def build_scorecard(run: Any) -> Scorecard:
  93:     """Build a scorecard from a synthetic or real run object."""
  94: 
  95:     tokens_cached = _get_int(run, "tokens_cached", "cached_tokens")
  96:     tokens_fresh = _get_int(run, "tokens_fresh", "fresh_tokens")
  97:     total_tokens = tokens_cached + tokens_fresh
  98:     cache_hit_ratio = (tokens_cached / total_tokens) if total_tokens else 0.0
  99:     action_type_breakdown = _build_action_type_breakdown(run)
 100: 
 101:     grader_reward_raw = _get_value(run, "grader_reward", None)
 102:     grader_reward = float(grader_reward_raw) if grader_reward_raw is not None else None
 103: 
 104:     return Scorecard(
 105:         verifier_clean=_get_bool(run, "verifier_clean", "pass_", "pass", "passed", "success"),
 106:         grader_reward=grader_reward,
 107:         steps=_get_int(run, "steps", "step_count"),
 108:         model_calls=_get_int(run, "model_calls", "model_call_count"),
 109:         tokens_cached=tokens_cached,
 110:         tokens_fresh=tokens_fresh,
 111:         cost=_get_float(run, "cost", "total_cost"),
 112:         wall_time=_get_float(run, "wall_time", "wall_time_sec"),
 113:         cache_hit_ratio=cache_hit_ratio,
 114:         no_delta_streaks=_get_int(run, "no_delta_streaks", "mirror_no_delta_streaks"),
 115:         verification_rounds=_get_int(run, "verification_rounds", "verify_rounds"),
 116:         recoveries=_get_int(run, "recoveries", "recovery_count"),
 117:         compaction_count=_get_int(run, "compaction_count", "compactions"),
 118:         job_survival=_get_bool(run, "job_survival", "jobs_survived"),
 119:         session_survival=_get_bool(run, "session_survival", "sessions_survived"),
 120:         action_type_breakdown=action_type_breakdown,
 121:     )
 122: 
 123: 
 124: def _build_action_type_breakdown(run: Any) -> dict[str, int]:
 125:     counts: dict[str, int] = {}
 126:     for record in _extract_tool_invocations(run):
 127:         tool_name = _record_tool_name(record)
 128:         command = _record_command(record)
 129:         action_type = infer_action_type(tool_name=tool_name, command=command)
 130:         counts[action_type] = counts.get(action_type, 0) + 1
 131:     return dict(sorted(counts.items()))
 132: 
 133: 
 134: def _extract_tool_invocations(run: Any) -> list[Any]:
 135:     for name in ("tool_invocations", "action_records", "tool_calls", "actions", "recorded_actions"):
 136:         value = _get_value(run, name, None)
 137:         if isinstance(value, list):
 138:             return value
 139: 
 140:     action_summary = _get_value(run, "action_summary", None)
 141:     if action_summary is not None:
 142:         records = _record_value(action_summary, "records", None)
 143:         if isinstance(records, list):
 144:             return records
 145: 
 146:     records = _get_value(run, "records", None)
 147:     if isinstance(records, list) and any(_is_action_like_record(item) for item in records):
 148:         return records
 149:     return []
 150: 
 151: 
 152: def _is_action_like_record(record: Any) -> bool:
 153:     if isinstance(record, dict):
 154:         return any(key in record for key in ("tool_name", "name", "command", "arguments", "tool"))
 155:     return any(hasattr(record, attr) for attr in ("tool_name", "name", "command", "arguments", "tool"))
 156: 
 157: 
 158: def _record_tool_name(record: Any) -> str:
 159:     for name in ("tool_name", "name", "tool"):
 160:         value = _record_value(record, name, None)
 161:         if isinstance(value, str) and value:
 162:             return value
 163:     return "raw_bash"
 164: 
 165: 
 166: def _record_command(record: Any) -> str:
 167:     value = _record_value(record, "command", None)
 168:     if isinstance(value, str):
 169:         return value
 170:     if value is not None:
 171:         return extract_command(value)
 172:     arguments = _record_value(record, "arguments", None)
 173:     if arguments is not None:
 174:         return extract_command(arguments)
 175:     tool_call = _record_value(record, "tool_call", None)
 176:     if tool_call is not None:
 177:         tool_call_command = _record_value(tool_call, "command", None)
 178:         if isinstance(tool_call_command, str):
 179:             return tool_call_command
 180:         tool_call_arguments = _record_value(tool_call, "arguments", None)
 181:         if tool_call_arguments is not None:
 182:             return extract_command(tool_call_arguments)
 183:     return ""
